task.description:
Final step of WF-03 follow-up: merge feature/WF03-gh387-followup-20260802 to main via squash-merge.

Procedure:

1. `git branch --show-current` — confirm `feature/WF03-gh387-followup-20260802`. If not, abort.

2. `git status --short` — record state. If uncommitted changes to project files exist, commit them.

3. Determine total commits:
   ```
   git log --oneline origin/main..HEAD
   ```
   Expect ~5 commits (3 batch + 2 docs).

4. `git stash push -m "orch-state-followup-final" -- handoffs/orchestrator.log handoffs/registry.json` — stash to allow checkout.

5. `git checkout main`

6. `git pull --ff-only origin main`

7. Create PR body at scratch/pr-body-iss0121-followup.md (or update existing).

8. `gh pr create --base main --head feature/WF03-gh387-followup-20260802 --title "fix(ISS-0121): incremental per-test UUID migration (GH #387 part 2)" --body-file scratch/pr-body-iss0121-followup.md` — capture PR number.

9. `gh pr merge <PR_NUMBER> --squash --delete-branch` — capture merge SHA.

10. Verify:
    ```
    git branch --show-current  → main
    git log --oneline -3        → shows squash merge commit
    git branch -r | grep -i wf03-gh387  → empty
    ```

11. Drop remote-tracking ref if needed:
    ```
    git fetch origin --prune
    git update-ref -d refs/remotes/origin/feature/WF03-gh387-followup-20260802 2>/dev/null
    ```

12. Force-delete remote if auto-delete failed:
    ```
    git push origin --delete feature/WF03-gh387-followup-20260802
    ```

13. Pop the stash and commit audit-trail files:
    ```
    git checkout main
    git stash pop
    git add handoffs/ tests/ docs/issue-reports/ src/design/
    git commit -m "chore(WF03-gh387-followup-20260802): record Step Final handoff (PR #<N> squash-merged)"
    ```

14. Update handoff file `handoffs/WF03-gh387-followup-20260802/step-final-backend-dev.json`:
    - status = COMPLETED
    - result.status = PASS
    - result.summary = "PR #<N> squash-merged; <commit>; branch deleted; main clean"
    - result.artifacts_out = ["PR #<N>", "commit <sha>", "merged feature/WF03-gh387-followup-20260802"]
    - result.issues = []
    - result.next_action = "WF03 follow-up complete"
    - completed_at = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ") — exact output

15. Update handoffs/registry.json: set status for handoff_id WF03-gh387-followup-20260802-stepfinal to COMPLETED.

If the merge fails or has auth issues, record in result.issues as MINOR. PASS as long as the code changes are merged.

Return: PR number, merge SHA, branch state.
acceptance_criteria: Feature branch deleted from origin and local
